name: European walking route E9, Rye to Dover
description_md:
The European walking route E9 spans 65.6 km from Rye to Dover. This waymarked hiking route is part of an international waymarked hiking network.

The route is signposted as E9 and requires about 19 hours of walking time based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. It involves 1072 m of ascent and 1065 m of descent. The difficulty is classified as hard due to the distance and ascent. The path passes within 300 m of Rye, 200 m of St. Mary's, and 100 m of the White Cliffs of Dover.
